At some point between [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The objective of the mission was to transport a group of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], composed of the families and friends of important Alliance leaders, off Cloud City and to the [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Kaliska]].<ref name="CC" />
